basis: real Claude Code 2.1.308 sessions on one machine, forced 5-minute cache (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M), usage and cost as the engine reported them. One run per arm: a mechanism and money check, not a statistical claim

abIdleGap.setup: Sonnet, a 231k-token context built over 3 requests, then 10.5 minutes idle, then one small prompt. Each arm had its own unique text, because two runs with the same text share one server-side cache (a first A/B was contaminated that way and is not used)

control.note: cold: the whole context was rewritten

keepwarm.note: includes the 3 pings; the context stayed cached

measuredTtl.how: 1.3k-line log, 6 minutes idle, the next request rewrote 109,938 tokens: the mod recorded cache-ttl 1h -> 5m

guard.interactive: the real $.ui.ask dialog shows the idle time, the context size and the rewrite price, with Send anyway, Compact first and Cancel
guard.scriptedPrompts: the guard stays silent for SDK and -p prompts by design

bugsFoundByLiveRuns: a ping right after a chat's first request rewrote the message cache (first requests are shaped differently from later ones), so the old stop rule killed keepalive: pings now start at the third request and forgive one write
the guard quote ignored Haiku's 5x long-context price above 100k tokens
fs.list reports a directory as kind 'dir', not 'directory'
fs.read cuts a huge transcript short, which hid 4 in 5 idle gaps and invented session ends: big files now stream through scripts/habits-fold.mjs
the gate treated a model the person pinned with am: as above need: it now honors the pin

interactiveKeepwarm.setup: real interactive session (pty), Haiku, 3 requests, /automode keepwarm 1, 9 minutes idle, 5-minute cache
interactiveKeepwarm.result: the cache stayed warm for 10 minutes on a 5-minute lifetime

autoEndToEnd.setup: keepWarm auto, no command; Sonnet pinned with am:sonnet, a 231k-token context built over 3 requests, 8 minutes idle, 5-minute cache, then one small prompt. The gate read the person's real habits file (249 sessions)

coldControl.note: same scenario with the gate refusing (the model was not seen as pinned): cache rewritten

autoEndToEnd.learnedCommand: /automode learned printed the idle-time odds (big chats 68% back within the hour), the keep-warm ledger and the route memory
